summary: holonet bench, the machine's performance face. Separates DETERMINISTIC operation counts (7 mod-3 ops per routing decision, <=2 hops/packet, mu=4 multipath, syndromes/QEC cycle, 16 audit checks -- the same on any computer) from HOST-RELATIVE wall-clock timings (route/QEC/teleport/gate/audit medians over fixed seeded workloads -> routes/sec, gates/sec on this machine). HONEST: times the CLASSICAL emulation only; the priced 9^t magic dial is excluded by construction; ordinary Python on ordinary hardware, so the times are a floor not a ceiling. Correctness face is `holonet audit`; this is the throughput face.
